title: Algebraic and FFT-Based Methods for Discrete-Time Matrix Convolutions with Applications to Semi-Markov Models
summary: We consider finite-horizon convolution equations with matrix-valued coefficients and their use in Markov renewal computations. A sequence is inverted in a truncated noncommutative series algebra, and explicit coefficient formulae are combined with zero-padded fast Fourier transform (FFT) multiplication, Newton iteration and Gauss--Jordan elimination. We prove exactness of finite-horizon inversion, deterministic perturbation identities, and left and right a posteriori residual bounds.
